description: Complete the act: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_vvv UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/vvv-compute); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the agent wallet. An opt-in moves no NET and holds none. Ask net_vvv_status where it stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_net_vvv, unchanged.
